rules.region: facet 0, x 6600-6975, y 1900-2115; only packets while our player stood inside count.
rules.monster: a mobile seen at notoriety [3, 4, 5, 6] that is not one of our pets (ours: notoriety 2 and tame/bonded) nor a red player (notoriety 6 with flag 0x20 or a human body: source.captures[].red_players_seen).
rules.type_key: lowercase name without a leading article; mobiles named like our pets but not ours are 'transfixed copy of <pet>' (they appear right after a vampire countess's '*attempts to transfix*' and '*transfixed*' over them: [INFERENCE] a countess ability).
rules.war_mode: flag 0x40 of the latest 0x20 MobileUpdate (Outlands 0x77 carries no flags).
rules.movement: intervals between consecutive 0x77 updates that changed the tile, gaps > 2.0s dropped (pauses); war/peace by the flag at the earlier update; tiles/s = tiles moved / time over those pairs.
rules.damage_to_pets/us: a '-N' (speech type 0) over a pet / us counts for a creature type when exactly one war-mode monster stood within 1 tile of the victim; '_victim_not_poisoned' drops numbers within 10.0s after '*looks violently ill*' over the victim (poison ticks); 'damage_ranged_sole' = no war-mode monster within 1 and exactly one within 12.
rules.swing: attributed numbers from one creature within 0.25s are one swing (summed); period = gap between its successive swings when <= 6.0s. Numbers include poison/bleed ticks the rule can't separate.
rules.kill_s: first '-N' over the creature (any hue) to its mobile_death.
rules.hurt_rate: sum of '-N' in hue 89 over the creature / (death or last such number - first such number), creatures with >= 2 numbers.
rules.damage_hues: '-N' over creatures came in hue 89 (our pets' hits) and 2417 (only during a successful Provocation between two provoked creatures, and poison ticks after '*looks violently ill*'): [INFERENCE] the hue marks damage from our side; pets/us take damage in 946.
rules.damage_taken_total_killed: sum of every '-N' over a creature that died in view: a lower bound on its hit points (numbers sent while it was out of view or before we arrived are missed) [INFERENCE].
rules.gold: lifts of graphic 0x0EED out of the corpse (mobile_death.corpse, up to 4 container levels) of that creature, summed per corpse.
rules.aggro: the first 0x20 that showed the creature in war mode: distances to us and the nearest pet then; 'toward' compares how much those distances shrank by the last update within 4.0s. 'first_seen_in_war' = already in war mode when it came into view (distances then are not aggro ranges). 'hit_before' = a '-N' over it came earlier (the pets opened).
rules.pet_heals: '+N' over a pet within 0.6s of 'You finish using veterinary supplies.' = vet; within 1.6s after its '*devours corpse*' = devour; else other.
rules.pet_damage_dealt: [INFERENCE] the gravebug melees, so a hue-89 '-N' over a monster while the gravebug stood > 1 tile away is the phoenix's (we never fought); for the gravebug only numbers while adjacent within 0.15 s after its attack animation. Numbers with another player within 18 tiles are skipped.
rules.pet_distance: Chebyshev distance pet-us sampled every 0.5s; fighting = pet in war mode; not fighting split by the last pet command we said.
rules.potion: '+N' over us within 0.6s of 'You drink a healing potion.'
rules.engagement: damage numbers (creatures, pets, us) clustered with gaps <= 15.0s; kills = mobile_death of a creature that took a number, within the engagement + 2 s.
rules.walk: confirmed own steps grouped into runs (gap <= 0.6s, >= 4 steps); rate = steps / run time.
rules.bard: a skill use (0x12 type 0x24 for 9/15/22) owns the next bard prompt's target response (the first target; provocation's second is ignored) and the first answer within 10 s: ok (ANSWER_OK), fail / beyond (ANSWER_FAIL, 'beyond your skill'), refused_calm_wait, refused_barding_break, refused_skill_wait (cliloc 500118 before any target), refused_cannot_see / refused_too_far (cliloc 500237 / 500446); no_target = no answer and no target; distances are us to the target at the answer.
rules.respawn: a monster first seen <= 12 tiles from us (it appeared rather than walked into view) within 3 tiles of where one of its type died earlier.

levels.note: Bounding boxes of the tiles our player stood on, split at self position jumps > 5 tiles inside the region (teleporters), merged when boxes touch (2 tiles, z within 5). Only where the player walked: the rooms are larger [INFERENCE].
